company: TK Accelis Group AG & Co KGaA
description: tk accelis GmbH is a global materials distributor and technical and infrastructural service provider for the B2B sector. The company was formerly known as thyssenkrupp Materials Services GmbH. tk accelis GmbH was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Essen, Germany. tk accelis GmbH operates as a subsidiary of thyssenkrupp AG.
